audit.whatIsWrong: Level 2 was given to Kennen and Levels 4-5 to Skill on both layers, while the whys beside them read 'you edge trades' and 'your gap-close and all-in overpower his squishy frame'.
audit.why: At level 2 Kennen has at most two of his three mark sources, so the stun is not yet available; at 4-5 Zaahen's dash and 850 pull beat a 170-range Lightning Rush once it is spent. The packet levelChart and the audited mirror both give those rows to Zaahen.
audit.corrected: Row 1 and row 3 set to Zaahen on both layers, ratings raised to 6/10 and 7/10.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slicing Maelstrom was called 'a long cooldown' with no figure, and Lightning Rush was treated as the tracked spike.
audit.why: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s at every rank, so baiting it buys two full minutes. Thundering Shuriken drops from 7s to 4s across ranks, meaning his poke pressure grows with points rather than with items.
audit.corrected: The 120s and the Q cooldown curve now appear in breakdown.cooldowns and spikes[1].text, with the bait-then-commit sequencing attached.

audit.whatIsWrong: The page never states how the stun actually happens. It talks about 'the E stun' and 'two stuns' as if Lightning Rush stunned by itself.
audit.why: Mark of the Storm stuns only on the third mark. Thundering Shuriken, an Electrical Surge proc and Lightning Rush each apply one — so the countable resource is marks on you, not his cooldowns. Riot's text also confirms Electrical Surge applies passively every few attacks and E grants attack speed on exit, which is why his damage scales with attack speed and reads wrong against armour.
audit.corrected: Mark counting written into spikes[0].text, dosFull[0] and dontsFull[1].d; the on-hit and magic-resist point written into breakdown.mid.

audit.whatIsWrong: No guidance on why armour is the wrong resistance here.
audit.why: Every mark source is magic damage and Electrical Surge scales with attack speed, which Lightning Rush grants him on exit.
audit.corrected: breakdown.mid now points at magic resist over armour.

edits.before: - Kennen Lightning Rush: matchup-defining — His escape. Burst when it’s down. Track it before every engage. - Your committal tool: never spend it on chip. - Your ultimate: the win condition — kill windows only.
edits.after: - Lightning Rush: 10s at rank 1, and it is a mark source as much as an escape. - Thundering Shuriken falls to 4s at rank 5 — his poke gets cheaper, not safer. - Slicing Maelstrom: a flat 120s. Fight the two minutes after it.

edits.before: Track Kennen's Lightning Rush before you commit
edits.after: Count Marks of the Storm before you commit

edits.before: His escape. Burst when it’s down. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Count marks, not cooldowns: once two are on you, walk out now.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Three marks is a stun: Q, an Electrical Surge proc and E each add one.

edits.before: Trade strictly around Lightning Rush: when it is down, run your full pattern; when it is up, give nothing. If behind, farm safe and let your spikes re-open the lane.
edits.after: Trade when Lightning Rush is spent and you carry under two marks. Electrical Surge applies on-hit and E leaves him with attack speed, so magic resist beats armour here.

edits.before: Kennen's level-3 spike is real: with Q (Thundering Shuriken) poke and E (Lightning Rush) energy for two stuns he can stack Mark of the Storm and stun you for free. Dodge Q, don't walk into the E, and wait for the 4-5 window when your gap-close beats his poke; if he burns E to escape you win the trade.
edits.after: Kennen's level-3 spike is real: three Marks of the Storm stun you, and Q, an Electrical Surge (W) proc and Lightning Rush (E) each add one. Count marks — at two, leave. Dodge the 950-range Q, wait for the 4-5 window when your gap-close beats his poke, and if he burns E to escape you win the trade.

edits.before: Kennen R (Slicing Maelstrom) is an AoE stun-storm but on a long cooldown and mostly a teamfight tool; 1v1 he'll use it to peel your all-in. Bait it or wait it out, then E (Golden Onslaught) into R (Final Retribution) when his stun and E are down.
edits.after: Slicing Maelstrom is a flat 120s AoE stun-storm, mostly a teamfight tool; 1v1 he spends it to peel your all-in. Bait it and the next two minutes are yours — commit your E and R once it is gone and the marks have fallen off you.

edits.before: Poke you down with ranged shurikens and kite with E
edits.after: Poke with 950-range shurikens and kite away with E

edits.before: All-in with E into R after his R and E energy are spent
edits.after: All-in with E into R once Lightning Rush and his R are spent

notes: Rows 0, 4, 5 and 6 already match the packet chart on both layers and were left alone. Zaahen's own ability names are still unverifiable from his kit file, so slot letters are used rather than the content layer's 'Golden Onslaught' / 'Final Retribution'.
